_doc: TEMPLATE STORY GRAPH. Nodes reference speakers by speakerId (characters/*.json). Demonstrates every engine story feature: linear narration, character dialogue, choice hubs with voiceKeywords + completionFlag elimination, combat triggers (triggerBattleEncounterId + nextNodeId post-battle continuation), scene changes (changeSceneId), party resting (healPartyOnEnter: half|full), hub auto-redirect when all flags are set (hubCompletion), and the engine-convention 'game_completed' flag that ends a playthrough.

nodes.text: Deep beneath the sanctuary, the stone floor hums with a forgotten frequency. This is the Proving Grounds, where every voice that enters is tested. Speak aloud to advance, or say 'Options' at any time.
So this is where the trials begin. My voice is both blade and shield here. Let us see what this sanctuary has to teach.
The chamber awaits your command. Speak a choice aloud, or tap it on the screen. Completed tasks are removed automatically.

choices.text: Ask about the history of the Proving Grounds.
Receive tactical counsel for the trials ahead.
Begin the Squad Combat Trial against three drones.
Enter the Echo Hall for the final guardian trial.

nodes.text: Centuries ago, the first architects of this engine discovered that acoustic clarity directly amplifies force of will. Every crisp syllable resonates stronger than a mumbled one. That is the secret of the Proving Grounds.
Remember: vivid, elaborate incantations score higher resonance and strike harder. Say 'Attune' to recover mana for free, 'Defend' to halve incoming damage, and 'Status' for a full situation report.
A single training drone hums to life, gears spinning as it locks onto your voice signature!
Three automated drones deploy in synchronized combat formation! Say 'Enemies' at any time to scan the field.
Outstanding. My incantations were resolute and my timing flawless. The Proving Grounds yield to my voice.
The trial is complete. The hub awaits: run another trial, or enter the Echo Hall when you are ready for the guardian.
The far doors grind open. Beyond them, the Echo Hall stretches into darkness, its walls mirrored and listening.
Every footstep returns twice from the polished stone. At the far end of the hall, a colossal guardian stirs on its plinth.
The guardian has not yet risen. What is your command?

choices.text: Rest in the alcove and restore the party.
Awaken the Proving Guardian and begin the final trial.

nodes.text: You breathe slow and steady in the quiet alcove. Wounds close, mana returns, and the party rises refreshed.
The Proving Guardian rises, stone plates grinding over a blazing core. Its wardens fan out across the arena!
It is finished. Even the guardian's overload could not silence me. This sanctuary has nothing left to test.

CONGRATULATIONS! You have completed the template campaign: every mechanic, every trial, and the guardian itself were conquered by your voice. Copy these data files, replace them with your own world, and your game begins. Thank you for playing!
